simple.meaning: אוֹרָה (ʼôwrâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “luminousness , i.e. (figuratively) prosperity ; also a plant (as being bright).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Kings 4:39. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוֹרָה (H219) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: luminousness , i.e. (figuratively) prosperity ; also a plant (as being bright)
definitions.full: H219. owrah I. אוֺרָה noun feminine light (late, Mishna id. , compare Aramaic אוּרְתָּא evening-light, moon-light, star-light , etc.) 1 light (opposed to חֲשֵׁיכָה ) Psa 139:12 . 2 light of joy & happiness Est 8:16 ; plural intensive אוֺרוֺת light of life Isa 26:19 (light that quickens dead bodies as dew the plants Ew Hi De Che Di RVm; see Br MP 303 compare חַיִּים אוֺר ; but Ki Ges MV Bö RV translate herbs ). II. [ אוֺרָה ] noun feminine herb (so Mishna, Ges compare נצץ , Arabic = lights & flowers , & Samaritan יאר = דֶּשֶׁא of Gen 1:11-12 ,) only plural אוֺרוֺת herbs 2Kin 4:39 (compare Isa 26:19 above below I. אוֺרָה ).
